scope: Forty five-minute member pulls against a Railway-hosted private-room host; soak evidence only, no browser, sleep, reboot, Windows or production claim

host.image: source build from deploy/railway/Dockerfile on the recipe-test lane
host.access: member pull over the Railway TCP proxy; one held page connection per pull

client.machine: macOS arm64, same LAN member store as the two-Mac lane

cursor: head_scanned stable at 11/11/0 for every successful pull

events.detail: Host-b held maintenance.lock and stopped answering pulls between roughly 05:05Z and 05:15Z; no host logs surfaced. Recovered by triggering a fresh Railway deployment (APP_PORT=19473 environment bump); volume data preserved.
events.attribution: host-side event; recovery procedure verified, wedge root cause not isolated

events.detail: member/ca.der briefly held the template-test CA from 05:45Z to 05:47Z during manual file management; the pull failed because the client could not verify the host.

conclusion: The Railway-hosted private host sustained a 3h16m five-minute-pull soak with one wedge event that a redeploy recovered and one operator-caused failure. Idle and pull latency stayed inside roughly one second end to end across the hosted path. The wedge class deserves a dedicated root-cause pass before any production claim; this record is qualification evidence for the hosted-container lane, not production readiness.
notes: Both detached volumes listed under the project are retained for the recipe-test and private-host lanes.
The soak measures member pull health only; it does not exercise publish, rotation, discovery, browser gateway or member-side custody.
